title: New Orleans Police seek public help identifying burglary suspect on Pittari Place
text:
New Orleans Police seek public help identifying burglary suspect on Pittari Place
The New Orleans Police Department asked for the public's assistance on Aug. 26 in identifying and locating a suspect wanted for residential burglary.
Investigators said that on August 4, 2026, the pictured suspect burglarized a residence in the 3200 block of Pittari Place before fleeing the scene. The department has released video footage related to this investigation and encouraged community members to view it for more information.
Police reminded the public that all persons are presumed innocent until proven guilty.
Anyone with additional information that could assist in this investigation is urged to contact NOPD Fourth District detectives at 504-658-6040. Those wishing to provide information anonymously can call Crimestoppers of Greater New Orleans at 504-822-1111 or toll-free at 1-877-903-STOP. Tips can also be submitted online by visiting https://www.crimestoppersgno.org.
Questions or corrections regarding this case may be directed to NOPD’s Public Affairs Division via email at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection).
